GetConnectionTicket.summary: Obtain connection credentials for a cloud application.

schema.description:
Region ID.

> When this parameter is provided, application instances are assigned only from delivery groups in the specified region.

Logon token.  
Obtain it by calling the `GetLoginToken` or `GetStsToken` API.
Logon session ID. Obtained via the `GetLoginToken` or `GetStsToken` API, and used together with `LoginToken`.
Logon Region ID. This is the Region ID of the workspace when the user logs on using a workspace.
Unique identifier of the logon device.

Job ID.

Required for non-initial invocations. Use this parameter to query the job status and connection credentials.

Delivery group ID.  
>  
> - When this parameter is passed, application instances are assigned only within the specified delivery group that has been authorized.  
> - This parameter is Required when the `AppInstanceId` parameter is passed.

Application instance ID.

> 
> - When this parameter is provided, only the specified application instance will be attempted for assignment.
> - When this parameter is provided, the `AppInstanceGroupId` parameter must also be provided.

Application ID.  

> Required on the first invocation; optional on subsequent invocations.
Tenant ID, which is the Alibaba Cloud account UID.

Resource ID.  

> When connecting to an Android Cloud instance, pass the persistent session ID corresponding to the Android Cloud instance.  
> When connecting to a Cloud Browser, pass the Cloud Browser ID.  
> When connecting to a Cloud Application:  
> - In the application authorization scenario, pass the application ID.  
> - In the delivery group authorization scenario, pass the delivery group ID.  
> - In the persistent session authorization scenario, pass the persistent session ID.

Connection properties in JSON format.  
The following parameters are supported:  

- authMode: Authorization mode, determined by the delivery group's authorization mode: App (application authorization), AppInstanceGroup (delivery group authorization), or Session (persistent session authorization).  
- appInstanceGroupScheduleTags: Delivery group scheduling tags. Supports filtering by multiple tag key-value pairs. Multiple tag pairs are combined with a logical AND relationship. Keys must have values, but values can be empty. Format example: [{"key":"Resolution","value":"720p"},{"key":"Name"}].  
- appInstanceGroupIds: List of specified delivery group IDs.  
- appInstancePersistentId: Specifies the persistent session ID.  
- avatarId: User avatar ID. The default value is "default", used to support assigning multiple session instances to a single user.  

> When connecting to an Android Cloud instance, pass the static field `{"authMode":"Session"}`.

Specifies whether to use automatic rotation resolution.  

>  
> - `true`: The session resolution changes according to the terminal display area. In this case, `SessionResolutionWidth` and `SessionResolutionHeight` represent the maximum values for resolution changes.  
> - `false`: The session resolution does not change with the terminal display area. In this case, the resolution is fixed to the values of `SessionResolutionWidth` and `SessionResolutionHeight`.

GetConnectionTicket.title: Obtain application connection credentials
GetConnectionTicket.description:
Issuing connection credentials is a time-consuming action. Therefore, you may need to invoke this API multiple times to finally obtain the connection credentials.  

1. The first invocation assigns an application instance to the specified convenience account and starts the application. It returns a start task ID (`TaskId`).  

2. Subsequent invocations must include the `TaskId` parameter in the request parameters to query whether the task has ended. When the returned task status (`TaskStatus`) is `Finished`, the connection credentials (`Ticket`) are also returned.  

>  
> - If the startup is fast enough, the connection credentials (`Ticket`) may also be returned in the first invocation.
